Dear Sir / Madam, 
Re: Audio Recording of the Earnings Call for Q2 FY 27 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations 
and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we would like to inform that Earnings 
Call of the Company for Q2 FY27 Financial Results was held on October 16, 2026 and the 
audio recording of the same is available on the website of the Company at 
tejasnetworks.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Tejas_Q2_FY27_EarningsCall.mp3. 
 
This is for your kind information and record. 
 
Yours sincerely,  
For Tejas Networks Limited
